title: KARZOUN-X: Resource-Aware, Safety-Gated Local AI for Autonomous Spacecraft Fault Diagnosis
description: Stable open research prototype for local spacecraft fault-diagnosis decision support combining telemetry anomaly detection, retrieval-augmented local LLM reasoning, deterministic epistemic evidence checks, deterministic action gating, communication-delay analysis, hard-stress evaluation, multi-model resource ablation, and auditable statistical synthesis. The software is not flight-qualified.
